log.text: Reclaimer signals in the archive hold suggest a scout was cut off from her squad. The archive index terminal may say what the cargo really is.
Quest active.
You woke in Transfer Cabin 4-C as the Cinder Wake left Haldis Reach. The purser wants every passenger at Muster Point B.
Quest active.
Check in with Purser Dray in the Crew Commons. There is time to look around before the jump.
An explosion. The ship's defense network, WARDEN, has declared the passengers obstructions. Purser Dray begged you to help security in Transit Corridor C-3.
Officer Iona Rell is with you. The forward sections are behind the security checkpoint and its WARDEN-controlled blast door.
Beyond the checkpoint lies the medical deck, where the wounded wait and a maintenance synthetic is fighting off WARDEN cutters.
The route to the launch bays runs through the engineering loop around the drive core, then the archive hold.
Reclaimers from the Lantern Office are in the archive cargo hold, among thousands of stored minds. Command lies beyond.
Chief Engineer Osei Marsh's last log: restart both coolant pumps. A replacement seal can be fabricated at the workshop bench.
Quest active.
Dr. Ilse Varga has a finite reserve of trauma gel and more patients than doses. Behind the quarantine seal, five passengers are breathing failing air. Iona sealed that door on Commander Varr's order.
Quest active.
Quest completed.

Quest active.
You found Senna Thorne, wounded, in cold storage. What happens to her now is your call.
